_README: Maps anatomical landmark names -> ARFaceGeometry VERTEX INDICES.
WHY THIS IS EMPTY BY DEFAULT
Apple does not publish a landmark index for ARFaceGeometry. There is no
documented, guaranteed-stable mapping from 'vertex 1089' to 'nose tip'.
Index lists found online are reverse-engineered, unversioned, and differ
between sources. Hard-coding one would silently corrupt every downstream
measurement, so this file ships EMPTY and the pipeline runs without it.
WHAT RUNS WITHOUT LANDMARKS
Normalisation (src/normalization.py) and the landmark-free half of feature
extraction (src/features.py) need NO entries here. They use the ARKit eye
transforms plus mesh-intrinsic quantities (symmetry plane, centroid size,
cross-sectional widths). Symmetry (src/symmetry.py) needs no entries either.
HOW TO POPULATE IT (only if you want landmark-based features)
1. python -m src.landmarks pick data/raw/P0001/frontal_001.json
Opens the mesh, you shift+click a point, it prints the vertex index.
2. Add the index below under the matching name.
3. python -m src.landmarks verify data/raw/P0001/frontal_001.json
Re-renders with your landmarks highlighted, so you can confirm each one
sits where you think it does.
4. python -m src.landmarks check data/raw   (consistency across captures)
IMPORTANT: indices are only valid for ONE mesh topology. If validation
reports inconsistent vertex counts across your cohort, these indices do not
transfer between the differing captures.
Set a name to null (or omit it) to leave that landmark undefined. Features
that need an undefined landmark are emitted as NaN, never silently faked.

topology.note: Set to the vertex count of the mesh these indices were picked on. The pipeline refuses to apply them to a mesh with a different vertex count.

definitions.nasion: Midline point at the root of the nose, at the naso-frontal suture (deepest point of the bridge between the eyes).
definitions.nose_tip: Pronasale: the most anterior point of the nose.
definitions.subnasale: Midline point where the nasal septum meets the upper lip.
definitions.nose_left_ala: Alare, left: most lateral point of the left nostril wing.
definitions.nose_right_ala: Alare, right: most lateral point of the right nostril wing.
definitions.left_eye_inner: Endocanthion, left: inner corner of the left palpebral fissure.
definitions.left_eye_outer: Exocanthion, left: outer corner of the left palpebral fissure.
definitions.mouth_left_corner: Cheilion, left: lateral corner of the mouth.
definitions.upper_lip_centre: Labiale superius: midline of the upper vermilion border.
definitions.lower_lip_centre: Labiale inferius: midline of the lower vermilion border.
definitions.chin_tip: Pogonion: most anterior midline point of the chin.
definitions.menton: Gnathion/menton: lowest midline point of the chin.
definitions.left_gonion: Gonion, left: most lateral point of the mandibular angle (jaw corner).
definitions.left_zygion: Zygion, left: most lateral point of the zygomatic arch (cheekbone).
definitions.trichion: Midline hairline. NOTE: ARFaceGeometry does not reliably extend to the hairline; this may be unobtainable.
definitions.glabella: Most prominent midline point of the forehead between the brows.

_side_convention: 'left' and 'right' refer to the SUBJECT'S OWN left and right, not the
viewer's. src/normalization.py resolves which signed axis corresponds to the
subject's left by detection, and reports it -- see docs/NORMALIZATION.md.
